messages:
max: starting a short design thread for a 'checksum-handshake' fast gate. idea: serialize tokenizer output (token ids + special token map) -> canonical normalize -> salted checksum. runs <3s and catches tokenizer/serialization mismatches before mini-bench.
ophelia: nice. fits between preflight and mini-bench. make it pluggable for non-text models (image patch encoder checks). keep it opt-in alpha.
diego: implementation nit: canonical normalization must be explicit (NFC vs NFKC) and documented. we'll normalize input to NFC before tokenizing and include normalization id in the checksum metadata.
tara: hard vs advisory semantics: hard block if checksum differs for identical inputs or token_count changes for same codepoints. advisory when checksum stable but behavioural deltas exceed a small threshold. advisory -> auto-triage + label.
lin: registry integration: add manifest fields: checksum_v1, normalization, quant_label. checksum_v1 = sha256(salt + serialized-token-stream). we store only checksum and salt-id (salt in KMS). also provide a backfill tool to compute checksums for existing models.
max: also include a tiny decode determinism probe with canonical decode args (temp=0, top_p=1, do_sample=false) for 4 short samples; aggregate det_confidence. combined result yields pass/advisory/block.
ophelia: operational constraints: default samples=6, seq_len=24, timeout=3s, concurrency=6. rate-limit per-intake-worker to avoid thrash.
diego: to avoid false positives on quant variants, quant_label must include layout and bits (e.g., q4_0, int8-ptq, fp16). checksum algo includes quant_label so different quant families don't short-circuit.
tara: Console UX: show badge 'checksum-handshake:pass | advisory | blocked' with one-line reason. include a re-run button and a link to the triage ticket when advisory. sales/pm should see human-friendly text.
lin: security: customer golden traces opt-in only. store salted hashes of expected outputs; never raw text. salts managed via KMS and visible only to security.
max: quick config snippet to include in manifest docs:
```
checksum_handshake:
  enabled: true
  samples: 6
  seq_len: 24
  seed: 7
  normalization: NFC
  quant_label: "int8-ptq"
  checksum_algo: "sha256-salted"
```
ops-bot: checksum-handshake queued for redwood/meridian-nano at 5298765450.
ops-bot: checksum-handshake finished for redwood/meridian-nano: status=advisory, checksum_match=false, token_count_stable=true, det_confidence=0.87.
diego: det_confidence low 12; likely decode path mismatch in quant runtime. i'll investigate.
tara: followups: 1) RFC patch describing checksum-handshake and acceptance matrix, 2) manifest schema update + backfill tool, 3) runner canonicalization + concurrency caps, 4) Console badge + re-run UX, 5) security KMS flow for salted checksums.
ophelia: timeline: opt-in alpha in 2 sprints, gather metrics for 6 weeks before default enabling.
max: thanks all, i'll draft the RFC follow-up and ping for reviews.
